stem_book: A small body A of mass m slides inside a large hemispherical bowl of radius R as shown in figure. If the body starts from rest at the top point A of the hemisphere, find the normal force exerted by the hemisphere on the body when it is at point B of the hemisphere. [figure: B is on the bowl with radius OB at 60° to the vertical] (a) mg/2 (b) mg (c) 3mg/2 (d) 2 mg
reason: Stem fine; the 60° is only in the figure (manifest paraphrased it into text). Bowl smooth implied
work: v² = 2gR cos60° = gR ⇒ N = mg cos60° + mv²/R = mg/2 + mg = 3mg/2
